GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrolysis? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrolysis.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrolysis.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrolysis.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and its Oxides.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Ecosystems.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on The Ecosystems.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Ecosystems.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Ecosystems.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
